An '''unidentified Jedi''' lived sometime before the [[Third battle of Felucia]]. They somehow [[Death/Legends|died]] on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]].

==Behind the scenes==
This unidentified Jedi was only mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'' video game]] on the collection of "Forgotten Jedi Gear" on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]. Their species and gender is not specified. Their equipment would not have been able to survive longer than the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]], thus they lived after the Reformation.
